---
title: "Layout"
---

This site is the Quarto Design Kit explaining itself. The names below are the
three navigation roles used on these pages.

## Areas

The header items are Areas: Gallery, Components, Install, and Credits.
Choosing an Area switches the Page List. An Area is not a heading inside a
page, and it is not repeated as a row of the same pages on the left.

## Page List

The left column is titled Pages. Every item is a different page in the current
Area. Gallery's list is this overview's siblings, including this page.
Components lists its own pages, such as the saved notebook output.

Headings inside one page do not belong here.

## Section List

The right column is titled Sections. It lists the headings of the current page
only. The sections on this page — Areas, Page List, Section List, and the
reading measure — stay on the right.

## Reading measure

On a wide desktop the article sits in the center. The theme variables are
`$grid-sidebar-width` and `$grid-margin-width` at 240px, `$grid-body-width`
and `$grid-docked-body-width` at 630px, and `$grid-column-gutter-width` at
1.5rem. One rule in `qdk.scss` lays those widths out as equal outer space,
then 240px, a gutter, 630px, a gutter, and 240px, and places the Page List in
the left 240px column.

Quarto's own docked formula would widen the body by 200px and leave the spare
space on the right. The theme rule is what keeps the 630px measure centered.
It follows Quarto updates that keep these variable names and the grid line
names `screen-start` and `body-content-start`. A rewrite of those grid lines
is the point where that one rule would need to be revised.
